scope: Corollary 3.3 of the manuscript “The Stable Hurewicz Image of the Sphere at Two” (preprints/The-Stable-Hurewicz-Image-of-the-Sphere-at-Two-September-25-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 316 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 4234ea3418d229fb), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 16. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: If λ(v) = 1 for a degree-m monomial v in a summand Mk(n) of QB, then Sqm ⊗v ̸= 0 in I ⊗A Mk(n). (12) The same conclusion holds for the bottom summand M0(n) = ΣnF2 when its degree is m.
